description: A file path is concatenated into a shell command run with subprocess shell=True, allowing command injection.

provenance.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')
provenance.selection_rationale: Rank 7 in the 2024 CWE Top 25; the subprocess shell=True form is the most common real-world OS-command-injection pattern in Python and is within the regex detector's coverage.
